data.long_meaning: The name Fabienne is derived from the Latin word 'fabulus', which means 'storyteller' or 'fabulous'. In the Christian tradition, the name Fabienne is often associated with the virtue of gentleness and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Fabienne carries the meaning “Gentle and Fabulous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fabienne usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle and fabulous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
